verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents Letta's own Agent SDK, CLI, App Server, and memory concepts extensively, but contains no mention of first-party integrations with LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or the Vercel AI SDK. The only related mention (letta-comm-3) is Letta's own admission that MCP client support was still 'in progress' at the time, not an integration with these specific frameworks.
